heading: INT. RECORDING BOOTH, DEFUNCT RADIO STATION - NIGHT

units.text: INT. RECORDING BOOTH, DEFUNCT RADIO STATION - NIGHT
Egg-crate foam on every wall.
A dusty microphone on a boom.
A reel-to-reel recorder with one reel running.
A lamp with a green glass shade.
MIRIAM OKONKWO-DELACROIX (60s, hair gone white, wool coat still buttoned) sits at the console with a thermos and a cassette recorder.
A red light glows on the cassette.
Testing. One, two. This is Miriam, speaking into the old microphone, Tuesday the ninth.
units.name: MIRIAM

units.text: Good evening and welcome to the Night Owl Hour. I'm Miriam Okonkwo, keeping you company until dawn.
units.name: MIRIAM

units.text: That voice has no idea.
units.name: MIRIAM

units.text: Tonight's request comes from a gentleman in Marlow Street, who writes: play something for my wife, we've been married thirty years.
units.name: MIRIAM

units.text: Thirty years. I remember that card.
units.name: MIRIAM

units.text: And so, for Walter and Eleanor. Here's the Platters.
units.name: MIRIAM

units.text: Walter died in the spring. Eleanor wrote to tell me.
units.name: MIRIAM

units.text: This one is for the ones who stay up late.
units.name: MIRIAM

units.text: I'm staying up. Don't worry.
units.name: MIRIAM

units.text: Which is most of us, if we're honest.
units.name: MIRIAM

units.text: Most of us. That's right.
units.name: MIRIAM

units.text: Because the night is long, and the dial is lonely, and I'm here.
units.name: MIRIAM

units.text: I am here. I'm here, dear.
units.name: MIRIAM

units.text: Stay tuned. I'll be back after this song.
units.name: MIRIAM

units.text: Station's closing Friday. Last transmission is at midnight. I thought I'd record a goodbye. For whoever's listening.
units.name: MIRIAM

units.text: Good night, owls.
units.name: MIRIAM

units.text: Good night, owls.
units.name: MIRIAM
